title: General
text: This subclause specifies the requirements for a UE that is not configured to use timer T3245 (see 3GPPTS24.368[17] or 3GPPTS31.102[22]) and receives a REGISTRATION REJECT or SERVICE REJECT message without integrity protection with specific 5GMM causes

NOTE: Additional UE requirements for this case, requirements for other 5GMM causes, and requirements for the case when the UE receives an integrity protected reject message are specified in subclauses5.5.1 and 5.6.1
